test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Mahesh was facing east when he started from home. He took two right turns and one left turn to reach his school. In which direction, is he facing after reaching his school?
solution:
According to the given information:-

 
• Mahesh was** facing east **when he started** from home.**
 
• He took **two right turns **and **one left turn to reach his school.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d93098eddae35644182535972275e94843f436f4825d7bb2dc7011dec377cf2d.png] 

∴ Here, Mahesh is **facing 'South' direction after reaching his school.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"South".**
